title.zh: 将南三宝颜省 Labangan 市镇 Upper Pulacan 描笼涯的 Bokong 国立中学的 Tabak 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bokong National High School - Tabak Annex in Barangay Upper Pulacan, Municipality of Labangan, Province of Zamboanga del Sur from the Bokong National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as The Tabak National High School,and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Bokong National High School - Tabak Annex in Barangay Upper Pulacan, Municipality of Labangan, Province of Zamboanga del Sur from the Bokong National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to be Known as The Tabak National High School,and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Tabak của Trường Trung học Bokong Quốc gia tại Barangay Upper Pulacan, Đô thị Labangan, Tỉnh Zamboanga del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Bokong Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tabak Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Tabak ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bokong แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Upper Pulacan เทศบาล Labangan จังหวัด Zamboanga del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bokong แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tabak แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Tabak, Sekolah Menengah Bokong Nasional di Barangay Upper Pulacan, Kotamadya Labangan, Provinsi Zamboanga del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Bokong Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tabak Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Tabak, Sekolah Menengah Bokong Kebangsaan di Barangay Upper Pulacan, Perbandaran Labangan, Wilayah Zamboanga del Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Bokong Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tabak Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Bokong National High School - Tabak Annex in Barangay Upper Pulacan, Municipality of Labangan, Province of Zamboanga del Sur is hereby separated from the Bokong National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as the Tabak National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Bokong National High School - Tabak Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tabak National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Tabak National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Bokong National High School - Tabak Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act, the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules and regulations shall provide for the school's organization, administration, operations and management, in accordance with Republic Act No. 9155, or the "Governance of Basic Education Act of 2001", Republic Act No. 10533, or the "Enhanced Basic Education Act of 2013", and other basic education-related laws.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days following its publication in the Official Gazette or in a national newspaper of general circulation.
